name: blender-game-plugin
description: Local Blender game and sprite workflow tools for ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and configure Blender sprite scenes.
interface.longDescription: Connects normal ChatGPT chats on this desktop to the repository's local Blender MCP server for structured game-scene inspection, PNG/RGBA sprite setup, and visual frame QA.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Blender game scene and summarize its current state.
Configure this scene for PNG/RGBA sprite rendering.
Render the current game frame and visually check it.
